newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Lippo Bank Q1 net up to 39.6 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Lippo Bank Q1 net up to 39.6 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Lippo Bank said on Wednesday it posted a net profit of 39.6 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997, or up 44.2 percent from the year-ago period.
Operating income rose 51.0 percent to 60.8 billion rupiah in the first quarter of 1997 against the year-ago period, the bank said in a statement.

"Prudent asset and liability management, together with a tight rein on expenses, were important in helping us deliver such strong results in the current year," president director Markus Permadi was quoted as saying in the statement.
Lippo Bank, a member of the Lippo Group, is among Indonesia's largest banks. -- Jakarta newsroomm +6221 384-6364
